title: pgvector & AI Vector Embeddings
description: Store high-dimensional vector embeddings, perform cosine/L2 distance similarity searches, and build RAG pipelines with HNSW and IVFFlat.

data.text: **`pgvector`** is an open-source PostgreSQL extension that adds native support for high-dimensional vector embeddings generated by AI models (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Cohere). It turns PostgreSQL into a high-performance vector database for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and semantic search.

rows: Industry standard for production AI apps

data.title: Semantic Vector Search with HNSW Cosine Distance
data.content: Finding the top 5 most semantically similar documents using the cosine distance operator <=>.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `pgvector` eliminates the need for separate standalone vector databases like Pinecone.
Use `HNSW` indexes for superior recall speed and accuracy.
The `<=>` operator computes cosine distance; `<->` computes Euclidean (L2) distance.
